extracted.intended_audience: researchers and authors preparing or reporting scoping reviews (and journal editors/reviewers assessing them)
extracted.subtask_description: Reporting checklist for preparing and publishing scoping reviews using the PRISMA extension for scoping reviews (PRISMA-ScR). Covers the 20 essential reporting items and 2 optional items authors should include when completing a scoping review.

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as one of the PRISMA-ScR items. See the PRISMA-ScR checklist and explanatory paper (Tricco et al. 2018) for full reporting details.
